title: Bulk-silicon reduced-model program
status_detail: Planning-only BulkSiReducedModel-v1 acceptance boundary. Direct-spectral fitting and the final direct-versus-Wannier comparison remain blocked by accepted production band-edge and Wannier evidence plus human-owned model and metric decisions. No child is active.
objective: Coordinate frozen training and withheld datasets, direct spectral fitting, Wannier-mediated represented-operator reduction, and compatible comparison into one reviewed bulk-silicon reduced-model milestone.
authorized_scope: Task kind: model reduction plus numerical verification; the parent performs no scientific executable.
Keep direct-spectral fitting and Wannier-derived represented-operator reduction as separate branches until parent, state-space, basis, gauge, energy, unit, and geometry compatibility is established.
Freeze training and withheld datasets before fitting and retain model hierarchy, objective, weights, optimizer, alignment, truncation, and residual identities.
Compare spectral observables separately from represented operators and report parent-model, numerical, interpolation, fitting, and reduction errors separately.
completion_criteria: Direct and Wannier-mediated branches are reproducible from accepted parent records and frozen datasets without withheld-data leakage.
Every represented-operator comparison establishes compatible spaces, basis/gauge, geometry, units, energy reference, and truncation state before subtraction.
Accepted metrics and tolerances are evaluated for training, withheld, spectral, subspace, and operator claims under their distinct meanings.
One human acceptance freezes BulkSiReducedModel-v1 or explicitly rejects the bounded model class.
exclusions: Spectral agreement does not identify a unique represented operator.
Wannierization is not described as a low-rank approximation and does not automatically define the accepted reduced model.
Incompatible error definitions are not combined and no impurity, continuum, scientific-validation, release, or publication claim follows automatically.
